keyVerseDR: "...he breathed on them; and he said to them: Receive ye the Holy Ghost." (Jn 20:22)

level1.title: The Holy Spirit Comes
level1.story: Jesus' friends were behind locked doors. Jesus came and said, "Peace be with you!" He breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus give His friends?
How does the Spirit help you?
level1.prayer: Come, Holy Spirit, fill my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Spirit badge
activity.intro: The Holy Spirit makes us brave. Color your badge.
activity.label: Come, Holy Spirit!

level2.title: Receive the Holy Spirit
level2.story: On the evening of the first day of the week, the doors were shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews. Jesus came and stood in the midst and said, "Peace be to you." The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord. Jesus said, "As the Father hath sent Me, I also send you." He breathed on them and said, "Receive ye the Holy Ghost. Whose sins you shall forgive, they are forgiven them."
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus give the Spirit and the power to forgive?
Which gift of the Spirit do you need most?
actions: Learn the 7 gifts of the Spirit
level2.prayer: Come, Holy Spirit, set my heart on fire. Amen.

activity.title: Come, Holy Spirit
activity.intro: Find the words from the hymn Veni Creator Spiritus.
